title: Sages helped by the gods founded a new civilization at Lake Van

tellings.quote: in that region was that those that group who were very very wise sages who were literally being helped by the gods as they describe it created something there

plain: Around Lake Van, in eastern Turkey, a group of very wise sages who were "literally being helped by the gods, as they describe it" created a new civilization. The researcher of ancient texts Matt LaCroix tells Michels this, without naming the texts he draws on. If true, it would mean a civilization was restarted there with outside help after some great loss.
